sources.name: City of Lafayette - City Calendar
sources.notes: Found and read on 2 November 2026 by the Lafayette build agent. lafayetteco.gov is CivicPlus. The home page's View All Events link is /calendar.aspx?CID=14 (the Events calendar) and View All Meetings is CID=29,41; the calendar's category dropdown lists Arts and Cultural Resources; Board, Commission & Committee Meetings; City Calendar; City Council Meetings; Collective Community Art Center; Fire Department; Lafayette Municipal Court; Library; Open Space; Police Department; Public Works; Recreation; Senior Services; Sustainability. The month pages were read as HTML (November: about 60 entries, mostly library drop-ins, board meetings, court dockets and closures, plus Lafayette Birds!, the Fall Mindfulness Walk, Wild Turkeys of Coal Creek, the cemetery plaque ceremony and the recreation center update; December and January: only council, court, closures and the library's drop-ins, so the City posts its calendar a month or so ahead). robots.txt (added 2026-10-20 by Add-RobotsRules) disallows /common/modules/icalendar/ and /rss.aspx to every agent, and /calendar.aspx and /CivicAlerts.aspx only to a named group of AI and SEO crawlers (ClaudeBot, GPTBot and others, not this network's agent); set to subscribe for the owner's decision, as the brief directs, and the feed was not fetched. The iCal catID is taken from the CID the site uses for its Events calendar and should be checked on first ingest. Library events are also on the City calendar under Library, so the LibCal feed below will duplicate them; keep one.

sources.name: Boulder County - elections, parks and open space
sources.notes: Found and read on 2 November 2026 by the Lafayette build agent. The county's elections pages gave Lafayette's two vote centers (the library and the Southeast County Community Hub, 1755 S Public Rd), the drop boxes and the 7 pm November 3 deadline; the Parks & Open Space pages gave the Coal Creek Trail (14 miles, Superior to Erie) and Flagg Park trailhead with a construction notice. The county's events calendar was not identified as a feed; its naturalists appear at the library's Tune into Nature series.

sources.name: Lafayette Chamber of Commerce
sources.notes: Found and read on 2 November 2026 by the Lafayette build agent. 304 W Baseline Rd, 303-666-9555, Mon-Fri 9-4. The /calendar page's Calendar of Events heading had no entries for this reader (it is likely script-loaded or a ChamberOrganizer embed; the chamberorganizer.com calendar URL tried returned 404). The annual-events page names the Peach Festival, a Lafayette Holiday Market, the Brew Festival and July 4 fireworks with no dates; the /peach-festival page (mislabeled) is the 2026 Holiday on the Plaza vendor application, which gave the one dated event read: Saturday, December 5, 2-6 pm, Festival Plaza. The footer carries placeholder contact text (+44 number, mymail@mailservice.com). The Oatmeal Festival is not on the site.

sources.name: Lafayette Public Library - LibCal calendar
sources.notes: Found and read on 2 November 2026 by the Lafayette build agent. Springshare LibCal, calendar id 10144, Mountain time; the HTML calendar loads by script and shows nothing to a plain reader, but the iCal subscription feed answered 200 with 500 events from October 2026 into 2027 (summary, description, location, categories such as *Storytime, *Workshop or Lecture, Kids, Teens, Adults, and a URL per event). 192 events fall between 3 November 2026 and 31 January 2027, 40 of them beyond the weekly drop-ins and storytimes: author talk, Tune into Nature, Lotería, Paws to Read, Older Adult Learning Club, blood drive, Friends holiday sale, board meetings. The library's own site is on lafayetteco.gov (/library, /Storytimes, /Makerspace, /LibraryEventGuide). LibCal's robots.txt blocks only named scrapers.

sources.name: Lafayette Recreation - Bob L. Burger Recreation Center
sources.notes: Found and read on 2 November 2026 by the Lafayette build agent. The City's recreation site (111 W Baseline Rd, 303-665-0469): hours and fees (/2575), the activity guide, youth sports (/118/Youth), swim lessons (/1984), School's Out camps (/1950), BASE (/200), the swim team, pickleball, the water park, the boathouse and the community garden. Registration is WebTrac (colafayetteweb.myvscloud.com), not read. Its special-events page lists only spring events (Leprechaun Gold Hunt, Eggstravaganza, Kids Fishing Derby), so fall and winter programs come from the activity guide PDF, not read. The renovation project hub is lafayette-listens.com/capital-bond.

sources.name: Boulder Valley School District
sources.notes: Found and read on 2 November 2026 by the Lafayette build agent. Finalsite. The calendar page lists the 2026-27 days off in its text (Veterans Day Nov 11, conference exchange days Nov 23-24, Thanksgiving Nov 25-27, winter break Dec 21-Jan 1, PD day Jan 4, MLK Jan 18, Presidents' Day Feb 15, conference and PD days Feb 16-17, spring break Mar 15-19, last day May 20) and links the academic-calendar PDFs under /fs/resource-manager/view/. The K-12 School Finder page links bvsd.finder.schoolmint.com; choice enrollment for 2027-28 is November 1 to December 18, 2026 in SchoolMint. Each school has its own Finalsite site (ceh, anm, lae, rye, sae, pie.bvsd.org); the host centaurus.bvsd.org does not resolve, ceh.bvsd.org does.

sources.name: City of Lafayette - Engage volunteer and activity site
sources.notes: Read 2026-11-02. The City's volunteer and Open Space registration site (Galaxy Digital-style). Its front page listed four dated activities with sign-up links: the Fall Mindfulness Walk (Nov 8), Wild Turkeys of Coal Creek (Nov 14), the Winter Wreath Workshop (Dec 10, waitlist) and Jack Frost's Winter Botanizing (Dec 13). Ongoing roles are at /GetInvolved.

sources.name: Lafayette Historical Society and History Museum
sources.notes: Read 2026-11-02. Hours (Wed-Fri 10-2, Sat 8-12), membership and volunteer roles read. Its events (Haunted History tours, History Happy Hour) sell on events.ticketleap.com, whose pages returned 'Something went wrong' and no dates. Board meetings are on the library's LibCal feed. Read again 10 November 2026. The site runs The Events Calendar; its REST route /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events answered 200 with 24 upcoming items in 3 pages. The first page (10 items, 10 December 2026 to September 2027) was all the monthly Board of Directors meeting at the library; none is worth a row. robots.txt says Disallow: /*? with a 3 second crawl delay, so pages 2 and 3 and the /events/?ical=1 link, which all need a query string, were not fetched. The route is recorded in feedUrl and the type left html: ingest adds date parameters to an Events Calendar request, which this robots.txt disallows, so reading it is the owner's decision (robots: subscribe). The Haunted History tours and History Happy Hour were not in the page read.

sources.name: Liquid Mechanics Brewing
sources.notes: Read 2026-11-02. The Events: Food & Trivia page loads its calendar by script and showed no events to this reader (its own note says to click a date on mobile). Hours read from the page. 297 N US 287 Suite 100, 720-550-7813. Read again 10 November 2026 in a headless browser. Squarespace events collection in calendar view (ingest cannot read Squarespace yet; robots.txt disallows ?format=json, ?format=ical, ?view= and ?month= to every agent, so only the plain /events page was meant to be loaded; the page's own script moved it to ?view=calendar&month=11-2026, and one direct load of the December view was made in error and returned nothing useful). November 10 to 30 showed 25 items: 20 food trucks, 3 Geeks Who Drink trivia nights (Wednesdays 6:30 pm), a Thanksgiving closure, and one worth a row, Corkscrew Hill live music (Mon Nov 16, 5:30 to 7 pm; also Nov 2, so about every other Monday). December was not read. Exclusions if it is ever read as a feed: Food Truck, Trivia, Closed. The Squarespace reader, 10 November 2026: this page is set to the calendar grid, which the page's script fills from /api/, so its HTML holds no events and the reader cannot read it; the list is at ?view=list, which the site's robots.txt disallows, as it does /api/ and ?format=json. Not typed squarespace. Two ways on: the venue switches the page to its list view, or the owner sets robots: subscribe and the feedUrl to the page with ?view=list (untested, since that address was not fetched).

sources.name: Odd13 Brewing
sources.notes: Read 2026-11-02. Six November events on the page (can drive, run club, ski waxing, book club, Black Friday early release, cookie pop-up), nothing for December or January yet; one listing had a 4 am start that reads as an error. Hours on the home page; no phone.

sources.name: The Arts Hub
sources.notes: Read 2026-11-02. The home page listed Little Shop of Horrors (closed Oct 25) and the Little Women youth auditions (Nov 2); the /events page's listings did not render for this reader (probably a Neon CRM embed). 420 Courtney Way, by appointment, 303-229-1127. Read again 10 November 2026. The /events page is plain Squarespace text blocks, not an events collection, so there is no feed and no ?format=json to wait for; a plain fetch of the HTML now returns the listings (robots.txt allows the page). Each show links to a Neon CRM ticket page (theartshub.app.neoncrm.com), not read. Nine performance dates fall between 10 November and 10 December 2026: Winter Showcase 1 and 2 (student showcases, Sat Nov 14, 10 am and 1 pm), The Addams Family in two casts (Thu Dec 3 6 pm, Fri Dec 4 6 pm, Sat Dec 5 2 pm and 6 pm, Sun Dec 6 2 pm and 6 pm; the page calls December 4 a Thursday, it is a Friday) and the first night of Imagine A Dragon (Thu Dec 10, 6 pm; it runs to Dec 13). After the window: Nexus Acapella Winter Show (no date on the page) and Shrek The Musical, January 15 to 31, 2027. No regulars on the page. Stays html: a person reads it.

sources.name: WOW! Children's Museum
sources.notes: Read 2026-11-02. WordPress with The Events Calendar (event URLs /events/<slug>/<date>/), which usually serves an iCal at /events/?ical=1; not tested. The calendar showed November through December 5: weekly Littlest Learners, two storytimes, STEAM to the MAX, Science Spot, plus the 30th Birthday Bash (Nov 7, 21+) and a Story Craft. 110 N Harrison Ave; hours and prices on /visit-wow/. Read again 10 November 2026. The feed guess was tested: /events/?ical=1 redirects to the /calendar/ HTML page and /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events answers 404 (rest_no_route). The calendar is the museum's own plugin (wp-content/plugins/wow-events), not The Events Calendar, so there is no feed; robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/. The page's list for mid November was all regulars (Storytime, Littlest Learners, STEAM to the MAX!, Story Craft with Korrie) plus Sensory Friendly Playtime with a sensory-friendly Santa (Sun Nov 15, 10 am to noon), the one item worth a row.

sources.name: Centaurus High School
sources.notes: Read 2026-11-02. A Finalsite site whose month grid is at /about/calendar?cal_date=YYYY-MM-01 (robots.txt allows it; /fs/ is disallowed except named pages). The grid carries the district's no-school days, the food-service menus and athletics entries (Boys Varsity Wrestling vs Fairview, Dec 3), but its dance-team entries have placeholder times and a Houston address. The home page listed the orchestra fall concert (Nov 3), a Theater Show Week (Nov 9-11, no title), the choice-enrollment showcase (Nov 10) and tours, coffee with the principal and graduation (May 15, 2027, CU Events Center). The athletics calendar proper is ArbiterLive (School/Calendar/3592), which refuses automated readers.

sources.name: Lafayette Listens - City project hub
sources.notes: Read 2026-11-02. EngagementHQ. The home page rendered only its title; the capital-bond project page gave the $40 million 2026 bond series, the $34 million recreation center cost and the design-to-April-2027, construction-from-2027 timeline. The find-a-schedule page names the JUMP (Boulder / Lafayette / Erie), 225 (via Baseline), DASH (via Louisville) and 228 (Lafayette / Louisville / Broomfield); the app.rtd-denver.com route pages are script-only, and the schedule PDFs at schedule-pdfs.rtd-denver.com/api/file/current/<route>/<direction>/<n> were read (n=2 was the Sunday/holiday sheet, effective September 27, 2026 to January 2, 2027).

sources.name: Nissi's Entertainment and Events (show calendar)
sources.defaultVenue: Nissi's Entertainment and Events, 1455 Coal Creek Dr, Unit T, Lafayette, CO 80026
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. 1455 Coal Creek Dr, Unit T, Lafayette, CO 80026, 720-535-7113 (the site's footer). A live music and comedy room with dinner; WordPress with Modern Events Calendar, the plugin ingest already reads for niwot.com. The feed at /events/feed/ answered 200 as RSS with mec:startDate and mec:startHour on each item, but it holds only the next 10 events (10 to 20 November on this read; ?paged=2 returns the same ten), so a weekly read sees every show only about ten days ahead. The site-wide iCal (?mec-ical-feed=1) is off and there is no tribe route. The /events/ page (it redirects to /shows/) listed 20 dated shows from 10 November to 5 December and nothing yet for 6 to 10 December. 18 are worth a row: Jack Hadley Band (Wed Nov 11), Hazel Miller and The Collective (Thu Nov 12), 90's Alt Nation (Fri Nov 13), Smokin' (Sat Nov 14), Under One Sky: Kutandara's Annual Benefit Concert (Sun Nov 15), Face Vocal Band (Tue Nov 17), ThreeShots Band (Wed Nov 18), Gone2Long (Thu Nov 19), Comedy Works Presents Tammy Pescatelli (Fri Nov 20), The Yachties (Sat Nov 21), Thanksgiving Eve with The Long Run (Wed Nov 25), Citizen Dan (Fri Nov 27), Those Crazy Nights (Sat Nov 28), Mike Masse (Sun Nov 29), Face Vocal Band's Christmas show (Mon Nov 30 and Tue Dec 1, one item), Midnight Hour Band (Thu Dec 3), Disco Revue (Fri Dec 4) and Bingo Loco: Christmas Special (Sat Dec 5). Most shows start at 7:30 pm. No regulars. Not for a row: Private Event (Wed Dec 2) and 100+ Women Who Care (Tue Nov 10, a giving circle's meeting); both are in excludeTitles. robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/, so the feed is allowed.

sources.name: Muse Performance Space (jazz and listening room)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. 200 E South Boulder Rd, Lafayette, CO 80026 (the site's footer). A nonprofit jazz and listening room with an art gallery. WordPress, but the Upcoming Shows page is an empty shell to a plain fetch: a VenuePilot ticket widget fills it by script (widget.venuepilot.com, which posts to www.venuepilot.co/graphql), so there is no iCal, RSS or JSON feed that ingest can read, and it was read in a headless browser. 14 shows are dated 10 November to 10 December 2026, 13 of them worth a row: Max Wagner Quartet (Fri Nov 13), Katelyn Klickman (Sat Nov 14), Thunder Hill Jazz Band: The Songs of Diana Krall (Sun Nov 15), Johnsmith and Dan Sebranek (Fri Nov 20), Colorado Jazz Ambassadors Big Band (Sat Nov 21), Christmas Comes Early with Cody Qualls (Sun Nov 22), Things of This Nature / Webistics (Fri Nov 27), a Boulder Rotary Club fundraising party for the Imagination Library (Sat Nov 28, 5 pm, free), Oh Snap! (Wed Dec 2, 7:30 pm), Jason Greenlaw Quintet (Thu Dec 3), Swingin' the Holidays with Eric Gunnison and the CJRO Ensemble (Sat Dec 5), the 5th Annual Jazzy Hanukkah with the Domi Edson Trio (Wed Dec 9) and Jeremiah Young (Thu Dec 10); nearly all at 7 pm. One regular: the Muse Jazz Jam with the Clare Church Trio (Mon Nov 30, and again Dec 28). Six more shows are listed to 28 December and one for 8 January 2027. robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/. Typed html because a person can read the page; a plain fetch of it shows no dates.

sources.name: Theater Company of Lafayette (community theatre)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Plays at the Arapaho Center, formerly the Mary Miller Theater, 300 E Simpson St, Lafayette, CO 80026 (the site's contact page); the guide has the theater as a place. WordPress with no events plugin and no feed; the current show is on the home page and tickets sell on zeffy.com (not read). The season page (/tcl-season/) is an image with no text, and /season/ is a 404. One production is on: Twilight Zone!, 30 October to 15 November 2026, Fridays and Saturdays at 7:30 pm and Sundays at 2 pm, which leaves 3 performances between 10 November and 10 December worth a row (Fri Nov 13, Sat Nov 14, Sun Nov 15). Nothing later is announced on the pages read. No regulars. robots.txt is empty, so nothing is disallowed. Check monthly: the company stages a handful of runs a year.

sources.name: Dog House Music Studios and The End Lafayette (concerts and community events)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. 525 Courtney Way, Lafayette, CO 80026 (on every listing). A rehearsal and recording studio whose small venue, The End Lafayette, is now run by its nonprofit, Rock for the People. Wix site with the Wix Events widget, which publishes no public feed; the /calendar page was read in a headless browser. 9 items are dated 10 November to 10 December 2026. 3 are worth a row: Lafayette Living Room Sessions presents Resisting B!tch Face with Carly Fox and Friends (Fri Nov 13, 7 pm), Lafayette Living Room Sessions presents the Lafayette Songwriters Showcase (Fri Nov 20, 7 pm) and Improv Boulder presents LAUGHayette! (Fri Dec 4, 7:30 pm). 6 are regulars: Band Speed Dating (Tue Nov 10), the Songwriters Meetup (Wed Nov 11 and Dec 9), Amplified Open Mic Night (Tue Nov 17), Acoustic Open Mic Night (Tue Nov 24) and the Femme Musicians Meetup and Jam (Tue Dec 1). Just after the window: Soulma and The CDC (Fri Dec 11) and Rock For The People presents Wild Love Tigress and Jaguar Stevens (Sat Dec 12). robots.txt allows everything but ?lightbox= links. Exclusions if a feed ever appears: Meetup, Open Mic, Speed Dating. Studio tour bookings on the same site are not events.

sources.name: Center for Musical Arts (concert series and recitals)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. 200 E Baseline Rd, Lafayette, CO 80026 (the venue record in the feed). A nonprofit community music school; comusic.org is an older Squarespace front that links here. WordPress with The Events Calendar; the REST route answered 200 with 12 upcoming items, time zone America/Denver, each with a venue. 2 are dated 10 November to 10 December 2026: Bade Dastan, violin, and Mark Livshits, piano, in the 2026-27 Concert Series (Fri Nov 13, 7:30 pm), worth a row, and the CMA Student Open Recital (Sun Nov 15, 5 pm), which the editor may or may not want. No regulars. Just after the window the feed has five concerts in one week (Rocky Mountain Concert Band, Dec 13, at Atonement Lutheran Church in Boulder, which the location filter keeps out; two Monday Jazz Combo concerts Dec 14; the Advanced Jazz Ensemble Dec 16; the Rocky Mountain Big Band Dec 17), then the concert series monthly to April 2027. robots.txt has an empty Disallow and a 10 second crawl delay, so the feed is allowed; two requests were made ten seconds apart. Exclusion suggested: Master Class. Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("Go 1 to 3", DECISIONS.md, "Twenty-four sources turned on"): the feed is one robots.txt allows, so it is read under honor.

sources.name: pARTiculars Art Gallery and Teaching Studio (2nd Friday openings and classes)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. 401 South Public Road, Lafayette (the venue record in the feed). An artists' cooperative gallery with a teaching studio. WordPress with The Events Calendar (its calendar page is /courses/); the REST route answered 200, time zone America/Denver, with 22 items dated 10 November to 10 December 2026. 1 is worth a row: November 2nd Friday in Lafayette, featured artist Peter Steele (Fri Nov 13, 4:30 pm), the gallery's monthly opening. The other 21 are paid art classes, which are regulars at best: beaded earrings, watercolor holiday cards, wet felting, silk painting, mosaics, fused glass, embroidery, branch weaving, leather journals. Three of the classes are not at the gallery (an Erie studio with no venue, and a private home studio on Cimarron Drive in Lafayette). Because class titles never repeat, the exclusion is written the other way round, as one regular expression that keeps out every title that does not name a 2nd Friday, a featured artist, a reception, an art walk, an open studio or a holiday market; the editor should check it against the first read. robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/, so the feed is allowed. No defaultVenue is set because of the off-site classes.

sources.name: The Read Queen Bookstore and Cafe (author events)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. 129 N Harrison Ave, Lafayette, CO 80026 (the guide's place file). WordPress with The Events Calendar; the REST route answered 200, time zone America/Denver, with 1 upcoming item in all: Meet the Author Kristin Koval (Thu Nov 12, 6:30 pm), held at the Lafayette Public Library and already in the guide from the library's feed, so it adds nothing new this month and would duplicate that listing. No regulars and nothing else dated 10 November to 10 December 2026. A request for the past three months' items returned a page that was not JSON, so how often the shop posts is not known. robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/, so the feed is allowed. No defaultVenue is set because the one item read was at the library.

sources.name: Acreage by Stem Ciders (events)
sources.defaultVenue: Acreage by Stem Ciders, 1380 Horizon Ave, Unit A, Lafayette, CO 80026
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. 1380 Horizon Ave, Unit A, Lafayette, CO 80026 (the guide's place file; the feed's venue is Acreage, Lafayette). WordPress with The Events Calendar; the REST route answered 200, time zone America/Denver, with 0 upcoming items, so nothing is dated 10 November to 10 December 2026. The same route for 1 August to 9 November 2026 held 7: the Colorado 150th Keep the Glass Celebration (Aug 1), the Gold Rush Crit Race (Aug 20), a Gravel Ride (Aug 26), three Silent Yoga on the Lawn evenings and a month-long Celebrate Cider Month marker (Oct 1). So it is a summer calendar of two or three one-off events a month and it is empty in winter. The home page links a pumpkin patch ticket page on events.denverbeerco.com, not read. robots.txt has an empty Disallow and a 10 second crawl delay, so the feed is allowed. Exclusions suggested: Yoga (a regular) and the Celebrate Cider Month marker.

sources.name: Three Leaf Farm (farm dinners, workshops, Art in the Barn)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. 445 S. 112th St., Lafayette, CO 80026, 303-815-7647, at the corner of US 287 and S. Public Rd (the site's footer); a private residence open to the public only during events and workshops. Squarespace; the schedule is a plain text list by month on one page, not an events collection, so there is no feed. 2 items are dated 10 November to 10 December 2026: the Art in the Barn Holiday Market (Sat Dec 5), worth a row, and the Full Moon Workshop: Enchanted Yule (Mon Nov 23, 6 to 8 pm), a class and marked sold out. The 2027 list on the same page runs through the year with full moon workshops, farm dinners (one in September still marked TBD), and Art in the Barn again on 4 December 2027; the site also has pages for a Botanica Festival and farm dinners, not read. robots.txt is Squarespace's default: the pages are allowed, ?format=json is not. Times and prices for the holiday market were not on the schedule page.

sources.name: Ghost Box Pizza (events)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. 103 S Public Rd, Lafayette (the page's footer and the guide's place file). A SpotHopper restaurant site with an events page that a plain fetch can read; no feed. 2 items dated 10 November to 10 December 2026 are worth a row: November Holiday Ornament Making with Cannon Ceramics (Fri Nov 13, 7 pm, ticketed) and Stuffing After Dark, a night of live music on Thanksgiving eve (Wed Nov 25, 8 pm to late). Regulars: Geeks Who Drink Trivia every Tuesday at 6 pm and Music Bingo every Wednesday at 6 pm. Not events: the Football Is Back and gift card promotions, which run for months. Just after the window: December Holiday Ornament Making (Fri Dec 11, 7 pm). robots.txt names no disallowed path.
